judgement.reason: Mealie supports PostgreSQL and its local file storage (recipe images) is a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is acceptable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME $MEALIE_HOME/data/ (docker/Dockerfile), volume mealie-data:/app/data/ (docker/docker-compose.yml mealie)
reviews.reason: Although DB_ENGINE can select PostgreSQL, the shown lines do not prove that the data directory holds only the database; Mealie also stores recipe images and backups there, and no setting routes those to S3.
